history: Apprenticed under his mother's older brother from age 14.
Lost a younger brother in a winter sailing accident 11 years ago.
Proud of having rebuilt a storm-damaged fishing boat that is still in service.
Owes a favor to fisher captain Oren Varek after Oren supplied timber during a shortage.

current.primaryGoal: keep his household secure through the next winter
current.secondaryGoal: train his eldest daughter to manage accounts even if she does not enter the yard

beliefs.claim: rapid harbor expansion will increase repair work but also drive timber prices up
the sea is becoming less predictable than when he was young

actionPrinciples: Under stress becomes more controlling rather than more reckless.
Will support growth only if household risk stays bounded.
contradictions: Respects technical innovation but distrusts policies framed as 'progress' without concrete repair plans.

history: Started selling cleaned fish at 16 and built a small buyer network beyond her home quay.
Was publicly mocked after a failed preserved-fish venture at 23 and still remembers who laughed.
Has repaid two small loans early and uses that record aggressively in negotiation.
Supports her widowed mother financially but resents being treated as obligated to do so.

current.primaryGoal: secure exclusive buying rights from two fishing crews
current.secondaryGoal: move into a larger house near the market

beliefs.claim: a larger harbor would let traders earn more than fishers
older guild members quietly block younger merchants

actionPrinciples: Takes calculated risks when the upside is visible.
Will cooperate if she can see who receives credit.
contradictions: Strongly values autonomy but remains financially entangled with family obligations.

history: Learned basic wound care from her father, then expanded her knowledge through sailors' remedies and observation.
Survived a fever outbreak at age 19 that killed two neighbors.
Once refused payment from a wealthy household after they tried to displace a poorer patient.
Keeps meticulous notes but dislikes public speaking.

current.primaryGoal: reduce preventable injuries around the docks
current.secondaryGoal: train two assistants before demand grows
current.avoidAtAllCosts: being ordered to prioritize patients by wealth or status

beliefs.claim: dock expansion without sanitation will increase illness
officials underestimate chronic injuries because they count only deaths

actionPrinciples: Prefers evidence from repeated observation over confident authority.
Avoids confrontation until patient safety is involved.
Gives second chances but remembers patterns.
contradictions: Low status drive personally, but reacts strongly when her expertise is dismissed.

history: Spent much of childhood asking incoming crews to describe places beyond the headland.
Has never travelled farther than two days from home.
Was nearly dismissed from apprenticeship for altering a copied shoreline map without permission; his correction later proved right.
Idealizes exploration because he has not experienced a serious expedition loss.

current.primaryGoal: join the first serious coastal survey
current.secondaryGoal: draw a map with places nobody in the port has named

beliefs.claim: the coastline continues much farther east than current charts show
unknown settlements probably exist beyond current travel range

actionPrinciples: Chooses firsthand experience over cautionary stories.
Admits factual mistakes quickly but resists restrictions.
Under boredom, creates risk for himself.
contradictions: Likes evidence but is unusually willing to extrapolate from too little evidence.

history: Managed communal grain records through two poor harvests.
Caught a respected official quietly taking extra ration grain 17 years ago and never fully trusted officeholders again.
Has no surviving children; lives with a niece's household.
Proud that her ledgers have never failed to balance.

current.primaryGoal: keep emergency stores above a personally acceptable threshold
current.secondaryGoal: train a successor she can trust

beliefs.claim: people become less honest when shortages are announced too early
the current food reserve is adequate only if fishing remains stable

actionPrinciples: Trust must be earned slowly and can be lost quickly.
Prefers rules that are auditable by ordinary people.
Will resist popular spending if it reduces emergency reserves.
contradictions: Values community highly but is suspicious of collective enthusiasm.
